```plato
    // A distance constraint between two grid vertices, its rest length read off
    // the grid's initial geometry so the patch starts unstretched.
    GridSpring(self: ClothGrid3D, columnA: Integer, rowA: Integer, columnB: Integer, rowB: Integer, compliance: Number)
        : ClothDistanceConstraint
        => ClothDistanceConstraint(
            self.GridVertexIndex(columnA, rowA),
            self.GridVertexIndex(columnB, rowB),
            new Length(self.GridPosition(columnA, rowA).Distance(self.GridPosition(columnB, rowB))),
            compliance);
```
